why_the_shortfall_is_not_obviously_the_i: Decidability is EVEN across the four runs (81.3-85.8% of enforced positions), so the control poet's higher rate is not bought with extra latitude — he is read LESS well than 唐寅 and still passes more.

The eight failing 唐寅 七絕 are identifiable, not diffuse: one 出韻 (子胥圖, 朝 下平二蕭 against 刀 下平四豪), one 三平調 (題畫#15), TWO COPIES OF THE SAME 打油詩 (開門七件事 and 除夕口占, 柴米油鹽醬醋茶…) both failing 粘, and four single 拗 hemistichs.
So the corpus contains 古體, folk verse and textual corruption beside 近體, and a 90% bar over an unfiltered Wikisource category is a bar on the corpus as much as on the verifier.
three_refinements_and_why_each_is_princi: 特拗 (仄仄平平仄平仄) exempted from the alternation rule — a documented accepted variant, not a tolerance. Four 唐寅 七絕 use it. Written before the rate was looked at.

A rhyme character ABSENT from the table yields UNDECIDED, not a failure — my own stated policy applied to rhyme. 邨 is a variant of 村 (上平十三元) and the table holds only 村; 題畫#3 rhymes correctly and was being failed for a glyph.

A poem whose rhyme positions share a 仄 group is classified 古體(仄韻), not failed — 近體's rules are not its rules. The test is a SHARED 仄 group, not 'no 平 reading': 比 has a 平 reading and still rhymes 上四紙 with 裏 in 宮妃夜游圖.
bounds: The rate moved 69.2 -> 76.9 -> 79.5% across the three refinements. Each was justified by a poetic rule before its effect was measured, and none was adopted because it raised the number — but the sequence is in the commit history and can be audited.
n=39 for the headline. Eight failures; one poem either way moves it 2.6 points.

A whole-poem STRICT rate (any ambiguous character fails the poem) is 10.3%, and it is not a useful number — it measures the 10.2% polyphonic characters, not the poetry. Position-level readability is the bound that means something.
Both 唐寅 corpora readings are the PUNCTUATED Wikisource text; 文徵明's is the UNPUNCTUATED 四庫 text. Same verifier, different editions.
